description.p: The Succubi are seductive demons from the lust ring of hell.
Your Succubus character has a variety of superior abilities.
Ability Score Increase. Your Charisma score increases by 2, and Your Dexterity score increases by 1.
Age. Succubi are demons, as such, they do not age.
Alignment. Succubi are deceptive demons, they tend to align more towards Lawful Evil.
Size. Succubus range from under 5 feet to over 6 feet tall and have slender builds. Your size is Medium.
Speed. You have a movement speed of 30ft.
Darkvision. Your Demonic eyes provide a superior sense of vision in the dark, you have 60ft of darkvision

Morph. You can change your form at will, similar to the spell Disguise Self. As an action, you may change yourself and all belongings to a new appearance of your choice for an hour, requiring concentration. Changes to your body are physical, while changes to your belongings are purely illusionary.

Deceptive Legacy. You know the Friends cantrip. Once you reach 3rd level, you can cast the Hex spell, you must finish a long rest to cast the spell again with the trait. Once you reach 5th level, you can also cast the Enthrall spell, you must finish a long rest to cast the spell again with the trait. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells.
Languages. You can speak, read, and write Common and Infernal.
